plugin.name: AardstatsEpics
plugin.author: TrEz
plugin.purpose: Pull & Display Epics - listday, listday [channel name]

alias.send:
-- Header Row: Command | Description ColourNote("green","black",string.format("%-30s","Command"),"white","black","Description") ColourNote("green","black","-------------------------------------------------")
-- listhelp command ColourNote("yellow","black",string.format("%-30s","listhelp"),"white","black","Shows this help file.")
-- listday command ColourNote("yellow","black",string.format("%-30s","listday [channel]"),"white","black","Lists epics for today. (listday)")
-- listnext command ColourNote("yellow","black",string.format("%-30s","listnext [channel]"),"white","black","Lists next epic. (listnext)")
-- listall command ColourNote("yellow","black",string.format("%-30s","listall [channel]"),"white","black","Lists all remaining epics. (listall)")
-- listepic command ColourNote("yellow","black",string.format("%-30s","listepic [NAME] [channel]"),"white","black","Shows specific epics only (listepic inferno)")
ColourNote("green","black","-------------------------------------------------")

muclient.script:
-- Output channel, defaults to echo channelOutput = "echo"
-- Get specific epic function getEpic(epic, channel) local async = require("async")
if channel ~= "" then channelOutput = channel else channelOutput = 'echo' end
async.doAsyncRemoteRequest("https://lightclan.net/api/public/epics/" .. epic, handleAPIResponse , "HTTPS", 5, nil, nil) end
-- Get all epics function getEpicsAll(channel) local async = require("async")
if channel ~= "" then channelOutput = channel else channelOutput = 'echo' end
async.doAsyncRemoteRequest("https://lightclan.net/api/public/epics", handleAPIResponse , "HTTPS", 5, nil, nil) end
-- Get next epic function getEpicsNext(channel) local async = require("async")
if channel ~= "" then channelOutput = channel else channelOutput = 'echo' end
async.doAsyncRemoteRequest("https://lightclan.net/api/public/epics-next", handleAPIResponse , "HTTPS", 5, nil, nil) end
-- Get today's epics function getEpicsToday(channel) local async = require("async")
if channel ~= "" then channelOutput = channel else channelOutput = 'echo' end
async.doAsyncRemoteRequest("https://lightclan.net/api/public/epics-today", handleAPIResponse , "HTTPS", 5, nil, nil) end
-- Parse response function handleAPIResponse(retval, page, status, headers, full_status, requested_url, request_body) local json = require("json") local parsedEpics = json.decode(page);
if parsedEpics and #parsedEpics > 0 then for i, v in ipairs(parsedEpics) do Execute(string.format("%s @W%s %s@w - @x215%s@w by @x153%s@w [note #@W%s@w]", channelOutput, v["startDay"], v["startTime"], v["epics"], v["poster"], v["noteId"])) end
else Execute(string.format("%s @x153No remaining epics@w", channelOutput)) end
end
